prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity native macOS app direction comp, composition variant B
Input image: the supplied Ledge concept is the visual reference. Preserve its black optical-bench world, typography character, violet-as-signal discipline, continuous notch geometry and premium native finish; do not copy its exact layout or decorative desktop background.
Primary request: redesign the composition so the notch panel is wider and more horizontal, physically attached to the centered MacBook notch and top menu bar. The top black material must flow from the notch into two shallow wings holding labeled module icons. Below, a single full-width Media workspace has large album artwork on the left, track information and precise playback controls on the right. No detached header and no gap between notch and panel. Beside it, show the dark Ledge Settings window with a graphite sidebar and Appearance page dominated by a live animated-state preview (rest, peek, expanded) on one continuous black strip.
Scene/backdrop: actual macOS desktop, unobtrusive and very dark.
Color palette: permanent true black and graphite, bone white text, tiny electric violet active indicator only.
Materials: black smoked glass and satin anodized aluminum seams.
Text: readable French sidebar labels Général, Apparence, Modules, Profils, Affichage, Permissions, Raccourcis, À propos.
Constraints: premium SwiftUI realism, obvious hierarchy, accessible contrast, smooth organic continuous corner geometry that visibly belongs to the notch and menu bar, no light theme.
Avoid: floating cards, gradients, neon glow, rainbow colors, detached popover, rounded rectangles everywhere, generic dashboard, sci-fi HUD, illegible microtext, marketing poster.
